# RKM Travel Hub – Ramakkalmedu, Idukki, Kerala

> RKM Travel Hub (also written RamaKalMedu / Ramakalmedu Travel Hub) is a welcoming stop for tourists at Ramakkalmedu in the Western Ghats, Idukki district, Kerala, India. It serves families, tourist groups, school and college tours, corporate teams and adventure groups.

## Contact
- Phone / WhatsApp (bookings and enquiries): +91 90746 85552
- Email: rkmtravelhub@gmail.com
- Website: https://ramakalmedu.com/

## Services
- FreshUp rooms and clean toilets for buses, vans and families
- Dormitory stay for groups, tent stay, homestay
- Campfire, swimming pool
- RKM Café & Snacks
- Spices shop and Galaxy Purchase Hub (home-made chocolates, toys, fancy items, spices, gifts)
- Offroad jeep safari (Tortoise Rock / Amappara route and viewpoints) – details: https://ramakalmedu.com/jeep-safari/
- Windmill and vineyard (Cumbum side) visits, local tourist information
- Bus and van support, free Wi-Fi, power backup, security

## Team contacts
- Anjith Chatterji – Dormitory & FreshUp, Galaxy Purchase Hub: +91 73560 05249
- Sijo Kunnumpurathu – Offroad Jeep Safari: +91 89435 75887
- Naufal KI – Spices, Offroad Jeep Safari: +91 62829 98798, +91 99614 92251

## Getting there
Roughly 75 km from Thekkady, 100 km from Munnar, 130 km from Kottayam and 150 km from Kochi.

## Nearby highlights
Ramakkal rock viewpoint over Tamil Nadu, Kuravan–Kurathi statue, windmills, Tortoise Rock (Amappara), Malamuzhakki Vezhambal sculpture.
